messages.subject: Re: plotOutput seems to make ui ignore conditionalPanels
parts:
Hi,

I believe it is not possible to use the same outputId several times in ui.R and that it is the main reason for your trouble (maybe the styling and formatting adds to the problem but I couldn't tell).

It is probably not best practice but I usually "multiple-assign" a plot in server.R if I want to call it more than once in ui.R
See below, I did that for GraphOne & Graphfive in server.R and it should work. But if for instance you call GrapheOne in each of the three panel it shouldn't work.

ui.R

library(shiny)

fluidPage(
  fluidRow(
    column(7),

#Selects GraphNum
    column(3,
           radioButtons("GraphNum", "How Many Graphs?", c("One", "Two", "Three"), selected="One", inline=T)
    )
  ),
 
  #creates rows and columns for graphs
 
  conditionalPanel(
    condition="input.GraphNum=='One'",
    fluidRow(

plotOutput("GraphOne")
    )
  ),
 
 
  conditionalPanel(
    condition="input.GraphNum=='Two'",
    fluidRow(
      plotOutput("GraphTwo"),
      plotOutput("GraphThree")
    )

),
 
  conditionalPanel(
    condition="input.GraphNum=='Three'",

fluidRow(
      plotOutput("GraphFor"),
      plotOutput("GraphFive"),
      plotOutput("GraphSix")
    )
  )
)

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  output$GraphFive<-output$GraphOne <- renderPlot({

plot(c(1:10))
  })
 
  output$GraphTwo <- renderPlot({
    barplot(c(1:5))
  })
 
  output$GraphThree <- renderPlot(
    plot(c(2:5))
  )

output$GraphFor <- renderPlot({
    plot(c(10:1))
  })
 
  output$GraphSix <- renderPlot({
    plot(c(5:2))
  })
})


I hope that helps,

Bastien
